sources.name: Project-Curated Pilot Headword List (EP-100)
sources.notes: Approach A selected: original 100-headword planning list curated in docs/ep100-headwords.md. Not an externally licensed dataset; no external word-list source is approved and no dictionary entries are imported.

sources.name: English Wiktionary
obligations: Elect CC BY-SA 4.0 only; exclude GFDL-only pages and revisions

Record source_url, source_revision, modified (none | minor | substantial), licence_id, licence_version, and attribution_text on every Wiktionary-derived field, displayed via Sources and licences and attributions.json; preserve supplied creator/copyright notices without inventing missing details
Keep Wiktionary-derived fields under CC BY-SA 4.0 in /data/layers/wiktionary/, strictly separate from /data/layers/original/ (All rights reserved) and MIT code
Exclude contemporary fair-use quotations and third-party media
LA-1 audit sign-off only: no Wiktionary entries authorised for import yet; D1, D5, and D7 release gates remain in place
compatibility_notes: Public GitHub Pages URL triggers CC BY-SA 4.0 Share obligations for Wiktionary-derived fields.
SHOBDO elects CC BY-SA 4.0 (not GFDL); original entries stay isolated in /data/layers/original/.

sources.name: Princeton WordNet 3.0
obligations: Retain WordNet 3.0 copyright notice (Copyright 2006 by Princeton University), warranty disclaimer, and title-preservation statement on all copies and modifications
Record source_url, modified (none | minor | substantial), licence_id, and attribution_text on every WordNet-derived field, displayed via Sources and licences and attributions.json
Do not use Princeton University or Princeton in advertising or publicity
Keep WordNet 3.0-derived fields in /data/layers/wordnet/, strictly separate from /data/layers/original/, /data/layers/wiktionary/, /data/layers/oewn/, /data/layers/tatoeba/, and MIT code
LA-1 audit sign-off only: no WordNet 3.0 entries authorised for import yet; D1, D5, and D7 release gates remain in place
compatibility_notes: WordNet License imposes no ShareAlike copyleft on SHOBDO original Bengali entries or MIT code.
Open English WordNet 2025 (src-oewn) is the actively maintained successor; src-wn30 serves as a legacy/reference layer if needed.

sources.name: Open English WordNet (2025 Edition)
obligations: Scope limited to OEWN 2025 standard edition (2025-edition / dc343f2); 2025 Plus is not assessed

Credit both The Open English WordNet Team (CC BY 4.0) and Princeton WordNet (WordNet 3.1 License), linking to https://github.com/globalwordnet/english-wordnet and https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Record source_url, source_revision, modified (none | minor | substantial), licence_id, licence_version, and attribution_text on every OEWN-derived field, displayed via Sources and licences and attributions.json
Retain Princeton WordNet copyright (WordNet 3.1 / 2011), warranty disclaimer, and title notices; do not use Princeton University or Princeton in advertising or publicity
Keep OEWN-derived fields in /data/layers/oewn/, strictly separate from /data/layers/original/, /data/layers/wiktionary/, and MIT code
LA-1 audit sign-off only: no OEWN entries authorised for import yet; D1, D5, and D7 release gates remain in place
compatibility_notes: CC BY 4.0 + WordNet 3.1 License impose no ShareAlike copyleft on SHOBDO original Bengali entries or MIT code.
2025 standard edition covers common nouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs (proper nouns moved to Open English Namenet).

sources.name: Tatoeba
obligations: Textual sentences only (sentences_detailed.tar.bz2 + links.tar.bz2); Tatoeba audio files are excluded

Credit Tatoeba (https://tatoeba.org), state CC BY 2.0 FR (or CC0 1.0 where applicable), and record sentence source_url, contributor username, modified (none | minor | substantial), licence_id, licence_version, and attribution_text on every field
Use weekly export datasets only (flagged 'red' sentences excluded) and subject imported examples to D5/D7 human review
Keep Tatoeba-derived examples in /data/layers/tatoeba/, strictly separate from /data/layers/original/, /data/layers/wiktionary/, /data/layers/oewn/, and MIT code
LA-1 audit sign-off only: no Tatoeba sentences authorised for import yet; D1, D5, and D7 release gates remain in place
compatibility_notes: CC BY 2.0 FR imposes attribution only (no ShareAlike copyleft on SHOBDO original Bengali entries or MIT code).
Audio corpus uses mixed per-contributor licences and is excluded from this audit.
